quotes.quote: We evaluated the composition of immune infiltrates through microenvironment cell populations (MCP)-counter.
The MCP-counter package in R ( https://github.com ) was applied to evaluate the immune infiltration of each tissue sample from transcriptomic data.

G1.rationale: The principal result is produced by MCP-counter computation on public microarray data, which a third party can re-run.

quotes.quote: the red module had a strong positive correlation with the infiltrating levels of T cells and cytotoxic lymphocytes (r=0.90 and 0.84 respectively, all P<0.05)

G2.rationale: One principal quantitative result can be named: the correlation coefficients of the red module with T cells and cytotoxic lymphocytes.

quotes.quote: Three chips ( GSE47472 , GSE57691 , and GSE98278 ) related to AAA were annotated with Illumina HumanHT-12 v4.0 expression bead chip

G3.rationale: The listed GEO deposit files are the raw/non-normalized microarray inputs used for the analysis.

quotes.quote: the original datasets underwent background correction and quantile normalization by “Limma” package
Gene co-expression network was constructed by the weighted gene correlation network analysis (WGCNA) R software package
The criterion of co-expression weight >2.5 was used to select the candidate network.

G4.rationale: The published method describes normalization, WGCNA construction, and module selection sufficiently to implement without original code.

quotes.quote: All analyses were conducted with R version 3.5 ( https://www.r-project.org/ ) and its several open packages.

G5.rationale: The method uses R and open-source packages; no proprietary software is required.
